Package domain.model

Class Cell

java.lang.Object
domain.model.Cell
public class Cell extends Object
Represents a single cell within a Hidato board. A cell is defined by its coordinates (row, column) and its state, which includes its value and whether it is a fixed number or a hole.

  • Constructor Details

    • Cell

      public Cell(int row, int col, int value, boolean fixed, boolean hole)
      Constructor to initialize a Cell with specific attributes. * @param row The row index of the cell. Must be non-negative.
      Parameters:
      col - The column index of the cell. Must be non-negative.
      value - The numerical value to assign to the cell.
      fixed - True if the value is predefined and unchangeable.
      hole - True if the cell is not part of the playable board area.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if row or col are negative.
